adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces two separate “credential sync active” gates that already differ: `refreshOAuthTokens` only uses the sync endpoint when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`, but `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema` whenever `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (no `userId` check). This creates a verifiable inconsistent path for team/other credentials where `credential.userId` is null: e.g. Office365CalendarService calls `refreshOAuthTokens(..., credential.userId)` and will refresh via the real provider when `userId` is null, yet then parses that provider response via `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, ...)` which will still think “sync mode” is active and apply the alternate minimal parsing + refresh_token placeholder behavior. The condition drift is real in this diff and can lead to incorrect parsing/state updates when `userId` is null.
